description: Purpose: compare a given recycled-content figure against the statutory minimum for one material, at both stages. Guidelines: supply material (cobalt / lead / lithium / nickel) and current_pct; thresholds are parsed from the regulation records in the dataset and the source record ID is returned with each row. Limits: one material at a time - this is NOT a compliance finding for a whole battery, and not advice or a declaration basis. Ex: calculate_recycled_content_gap(material='cobalt', current_pct=10).

current_pct.description: 当前再生含量（%），由调用方提供

material.description: 材料：cobalt=钴 / lead=铅 / lithium=锂 / nickel=镍

name: calculate_recycled_content_gap

text.description: Human-readable result (markdown, or a JSON string when response_format=json).
